content_of_post_to_comment:
I've struggled all my life with focus and procrastination and only recently have I found something that actually works quite well. That thing is telling yourself to only do the easiest first step of a task possible. If you can't do that, break it down even further.

I really struggle sometimes with going to the gym. I'd rather doomscroll on my phone. So what I do is say I am just going to get into my car and turn it on.

Now that the car is turned on, I may as well just drive to the gym. Now that I'm here, I may as well going inside. That turns into doing my full exercise routine.

Same thing with work, many times I just tell myself I am going to do such a small thing like opening the file I am working on. That's the only expectation I have of myself. And for some reason, it is crazy easy to go from there

It sounds like it's too stupid to actually work but IT DOES! I hope this helps out some others.
